title: PoliticalMayhemSpeechEvaluation
description: Structured output schema for Speech Evaluation AI across 60s rally speeches, verbal sabotage counters, and 15s Election Night final speeches.

speech_effectiveness.description: Overall speech quality and impact score on 0-100 scale.

ideology_scores.description: Per-ideology alignment scores (0-100) used by the deterministic Overall formula: New = 0.80 * Old + 0.20 * Speech.

persuasion_impact.description: Degree to which undecided or opposing voters in the city are swayed.

sabotage_effectiveness.description: Effectiveness of verbal sabotage counter-arguments (0 when evaluating an unopposed speech).

crowd_reaction.description: Dominant NPC Crowd Reaction System state triggered in Unity.

argument_quality.description: Coherence, clarity, and rhetorical force of the speech.

consistency_score.description: Political consistency relative to the speaker's established Overall profile.

feedback_summary.description: Concise narrative summary explaining why the crowd reacted this way.
